package.title: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro v5.2
package.author: Amazon Lumberyard
package.citation: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro, Open Research Content Archive (ORCA), Amazon Lumberyard, July 2017
package.note: All three package scene files are tested separately. BistroInterior and BistroInterior_Wine are overlapping variants and are intentionally not merged.

assets.name: BistroInterior_Wine
assets.note: Assimp triangulation yields 1,320,323 triangles; NVIDIA page reports 1,293,691 source polygons/triangles.

host.name: fox-laptop
host.workload: dedicated native benchmark; no concurrent renderer

method.outerWorker: one std::thread; main thread only joins
method.motion: listener moves 5 cm per sample around each authored camera; static full render geometry remains committed
method.cook: Assimp triangulate + join identical vertices + pretransform nodes; retain all geometry; classify render material names into six acoustic categories
method.dsp: not repeated because scene geometry does not affect per-source reflection/HRTF effect cost
method.rayTracer: IPL_SCENETYPE_EMBREE with one IPLEmbreeDevice per launch
method.timingNote: Embree constructs geometry during iplSceneCommit; total scene build is staticMeshCreate + sceneCommit

conclusion.allFullRenderScenesSustain60Hz: yes at both 512x2 and 1024x2 for every measured 2/4/8-thread cell
conclusion.production: Embree removes the full-render traversal deadline blocker, but structural proxies remain recommended for memory, load, and geometry-policy correctness
